reaction: The broad, clear footing makes practical sense.
reason: The only offered combination places the spare solar modules at the prepared site to add power.

effect: The separate solar circuit completes the chapter's power goal while preserving the growing room's supply; propellant production itself remains ahead.

mostWorthwhile.text: Installing the industrial solar supply was worthwhile because it connected the return plan to a concrete power need without taking power from the growing room.

leastWorthwhile.text: Preparing the footing was straightforward and useful, but less engaging as the only available action.

surprise.text: The chapter ended after adding power, before the propellant plant itself was built.

arbitrary.text: Neither action felt arbitrary: both had clear purposes, though the compatible choices were supplied rather than discovered.

continue.text: Yes. I would like to see how the solar-powered propellant contingency works and how the discovery is brought home, although this short chapter offered little choice.
